p1: Both sit inside the action area of about {action_area.ha} hectares. Neither is agreed yet, and both are described here as proposals rather than plans.
p2: Upland habitat on the Corrin side of the action area, outside the Glenabo catchment but part of the same walk and the same landscape.
p3: Wet ground with potential for habitat creation and for holding water back before it reaches the main channel.
p4: The phased approach runs from interpretation on existing trails through to a single connected loop.
p5: Trail signage with codes linking to ecology, biodiversity, flora, fauna, folklore and history, and to guidance on responsible recreation.
p6: The same approach applied at Corrin, reflecting its own ecological, archaeological and landscape character.
p7: Roughly {proposal.extension_m} metres of new trail to the rear of the existing route, reaching a forest track opposite the road to Waste Recovery Services.
p8: Linking Glenabo to Corrin to give a connected route of up to {proposal.loop_km} km, joining Fermoy Quays, Barnane, Glenabo Woods, Corrin Woods and the Cork Road.
p9: Any works would be subject to Coillte consent, environmental assessment including screening for Appropriate Assessment where required, and compliance with health and safety standards.
